measurement: Unchanged acceptance.benchmark(): full import, exact last-item search, restoration, sort, navigation, List density, Gallery, Gallery density, List, final density reset; fresh contexts and alternating order.
scope: Controlled diagnostic only. ok means completed correct workload, not absence of performance regressions. No publication, ceiling changes, forced GC, or removal of records/features.

completeLibrary.method: Complete baseline and candidate source variants; one warmup then alternating variant order, new contexts, complete import + frame/layout, exact last-item search, all DOM results preserved. Search/import timing method is unchanged from candidate1. Additional view/navigation timings use real clicks through frame/layout, after search completes. Browser fixture only; excludes native import and provider I/O.

comparison.scope: Three-action sums exclude harness work between intervals; not end-to-end clocks. No automatic no-loss assertion or modified release budget.
